candidate.reason: The title and locality in a FishBase bibliography entry, together with secondary local-name reporting, suggest a possible relationship to Lalaguna Marshland. No primary study copy or authoritative source explicitly crosswalks the names. Do not add an alias or a separate waterbody lead from this evidence alone.

bibliographicLead.bibliographyAccess: FishBase reference-list entry reviewed; no abstract, pages, original paper, table, methods, collection dates, or taxon names retrieved.

identityEvidence.finding: The Provincial Government of Quezon directory names Lalaguna Marshland as a point of interest in Lopez. It does not mention Dagat-dagatan or supply a fish inventory or geometry.

The historical inventory lists Lalaguna Marsh as a lake in Lopez, separately lists Dagat Dagatan Lake in Tayabas City, and lists Lake Pagatan in San Antonio. These are source rows, not proof that the Lopez bibliography's feature is the same as any one registry row.
The roadmap names Lalaguna Marsh among Quezon wetlands; it does not identify the 2007 Dagat-dagatan study site.

A third-party travel-page mirror quotes a visitor account saying residents call Lalaguna Marshland Dagat-Dagatan. The original social post and its authoritativeness were not independently verified; this remains a lead only.

FishBase's bibliographic title does not establish that the study site is Lalaguna Marshland or any other registered waterbody.
